advancedArguments.name: keyword
advancedArguments.description: Optional. A course name/title or course code fragment (e.g. "devops" or "000115") to narrow both the pending and confirmed participation confirmations down to matching courses - matches case-insensitively against any part of the course title or course code. When omitted, every pending and confirmed record is returned.
